name: A Cat Café Story
source:
Can you imagine the characters from A Hand in the Darkness, Chasing the Stars, and My Burning Heart as cats? And living in a cat café?

Well, imagine no more, this is it!

[From [url=https://ertal-games.itch.io/a-cat-caf-story]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你能想象《A Hand in the Darkness》《Chasing the Stars》和《My Burning Heart》里的角色，都变成猫咪，还一起住在猫咖里吗？

现在，无须再想象了，一切就在这里！
